propositions: A silently-inert primary dedup guard on comment IDs survived code review, test suite, CI, and 6 days of production because the comment_ids map was never populated by the transport layer.

The test suite passes end-to-end with the primary skip disabled because apply-layer tests seed synthetic id-bearing payloads while differ-layer tests use stub stores, and no test crosses the seam between real transport and real store.

The feature's plan-review gate passed despite the defect because blocking criteria E4 and T3 abstain on external response-schema claims and endpoint-surface granularity respectively, stopping short of the dependency shape introduced.

The guard returned silently under four conditions with no logging or observability, and a working secondary body-equality fallback absorbed enough dedup traffic that failures appeared as content-correlated degradation rather than total skip failure.
Production state (comment_ids=0 while bindings>2475) violated an invariant that existed in committed data but had no operation-linked observer to surface it.
